## Load dataset

```{webr-r}
library(Stat2Data)
data(BirdNest)
head(BirdNest)
```


## Visualise data

```{webr-r}
plot()
```


## Fit model

Is egg colour (0=plain/solid, 1=speckled/spotted) related to nest type? 
1=closed nest (pendant, spherical, cavity, crevice, burrow), 0=open nest (saucer, cup)

```{webr-r}
model <- glm()
summary(model)
```


## Visualise model

```{webr-r}
library(visreg)
visreg(model)
```


## Check model

```{webr-r}
library(easystats)
check_model(model)
```
